Every CSS code exercise must keep index.html as valid HTML. Raw CSS rules must never replace the HTML document.
Inline style attributes and <style> elements are allowed in index.html when a lesson explicitly teaches or requires them.
After the inline/internal/external introduction, learners work primarily in styles.css and edit HTML only when a task explicitly needs markup such as a class, id, stylesheet link, or inline style.

CSS Foundations inherits the completed multi-file Jordan Lee portfolio from the final HTML Foundations capstone. Preserve index.html, about.html, contact.html, projects/portfolio.html, and images/profile.png across the CSS course. Add or change HTML only when a CSS task explicitly needs a stylesheet link, class, id, wrapper, inline style, or style element. The cumulative styles.css produced by each module project becomes the starting stylesheet for the next CSS module.
